points.K3: 防护区：在受控环境里研究
points.S3: 二级实验室也有两道屏障

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼走廊，身后一扇关着的实验室门
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory corridor in front of a closed laboratory door, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，讲怎么把风险降下来。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着样品盒推开实验室门，用脚把门抵住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a sample box and props a laboratory door open with his foot.
shots.narration: 阿杰嫌麻烦，想把实验室门撑开。

shots.scene: 小研快步走来，摆手示意
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and waves her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研说：门也是一道屏障！

shots.scene: 阿杰一脸疑惑，欣欣出现在门边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks puzzled as the panda mascot appears beside the door.
shots.narration: 门怎么成了屏障？听欣欣讲。

shots.scene: 红色风险条，旁边几块积木逐块加上，风险条变短
shots.prompt_en: A long red risk bar shrinks step by step as building blocks are added beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 风险减缓，就是用措施降风险。

shots.scene: 几块积木互相咬合成一堵墙
shots.prompt_en: Several building blocks interlock into a single wall. No people.
shots.narration: 几类措施要一起用，互相补位。

shots.scene: 五块积木，各有图标
shots.prompt_en: Five building blocks, each with a different icon: a trash bin with a cross, a swap arrow, a cabinet, a clipboard and a glove. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施分五类：

shots.scene: 欣欣依次指过前两块积木
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the first two blocks.
shots.narration: 消除、替代，

shots.scene: 欣欣指过后三块积木
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the last three blocks.
shots.narration: 工程控制、管理控制、个人防护。

shots.section_title: 防护区：在受控环境里研究
shots.scene: 高级别实验室外景，门上禁止入内标志
shots.prompt_en: The outside of a high-level containment laboratory with a no entry sign on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 高级别实验室，本身是一个防护区。
overlay: 防护区：在受控环境里研究

shots.section_title: 防护区：在受控环境里研究
shots.scene: 实验室里的人员在安全柜前工作，外面一圈盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Inside the laboratory, a researcher works at a biological safety cabinet, while a ring of shields surrounds the room.
shots.narration: 研究人员在受控的环境里工作。

shots.section_title: 防护区：在受控环境里研究
shots.scene: 阿杰在门前停下，看着禁止标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops before the door and looks at the no entry sign.
shots.narration: 没经批准和培训，学生不能进。

shots.scene: 病毒图标被关在一个透明方框里
shots.prompt_en: A virus icon is enclosed inside a transparent box with a lock. No people.
shots.narration: 什么是防护？

shots.scene: 方框外几道控制图标围住，小点出不去
shots.prompt_en: Control icons surround the transparent box, and the dots inside cannot get out. No people.
shots.narration: 把病原关在受控的空间里，

shots.scene: 风险箭头被挡回去
shots.prompt_en: A red arrow trying to leave the box bounces back. No people.
shots.narration: 用各种控制，挡住它外泄。

shots.scene: 两层同心圆：里圈是人，外圈是房间
shots.prompt_en: Two concentric circles: the inner circle around a person outline icon, the outer circle around a room outline. No people.
shots.narration: 防护分两道，先看第一道。

shots.scene: 里圈亮起，小研在安全柜前工作
shots.prompt_en: The inner circle lights up around the female graduate student working at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 一级防护，护住做实验的人。

shots.scene: 小研的手套、实验服、护目镜依次发光
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student's gloves, lab coat and goggles glow one by one.
shots.narration: 靠个人防护装备，

shots.scene: 小研对照空白规程操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student follows a blank procedure sheet with icons.
shots.narration: 也靠规范操作的管理措施。

shots.scene: 安全柜前窗的气流箭头挡住小点
shots.prompt_en: Air curtain arrows at the front of the biological safety cabinet keep small dots inside. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，是第一道的主力。

shots.scene: 外圈亮起，整个实验室房间被罩住
shots.prompt_en: The outer circle lights up around the whole laboratory room. No people.
shots.narration: 二级防护，护住外面的环境。

shots.scene: 老李检查排风管和过滤器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks an exhaust duct and filter housing.
shots.narration: 靠工程控制：墙、门、通风、过滤。

shots.scene: 王老师把空白进出规程贴在门边
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator posts a blank entry and exit procedure sheet beside the door.
shots.narration: 也靠进出、去污等操作规程。

shots.scene: 两层圆圈同时亮起，外面的人群安心
shots.prompt_en: Both circles light up together, and people outline icons outside the room look safe. No people.
shots.narration: 两道防护，一起用。

shots.scene: 外圈有个缺口，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The outer circle with a gap in it is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 缺了一道，风险就漏出去。

shots.scene: 阿杰用脚抵门的画面被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a foot propping a laboratory door open is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的门，也是二级防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰放下盒子，把门关好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sets the box on a cart and closes the door behind him.
shots.narration: 进出随手关，不能撑开。

shots.scene: 缓冲间两扇门，一扇开时另一扇关着
shots.prompt_en: An anteroom with two doors: while one door is open, the other stays closed with a lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有缓冲间的，两道门不同时开。

shots.scene: 门上的指示灯亮红灯，阿杰等待
shots.prompt_en: A red indicator light above the inner door is on, and the young male student waits.
shots.narration: 灯没变绿，就等一等。

shots.scene: 五块积木竖排成梯子，最上面是消除
shots.prompt_en: The five blocks stacked as a ladder, with elimination at the top and protective gloves at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 选措施有先后：

shots.scene: 箭头从梯子顶部往下走
shots.prompt_en: An arrow runs down the ladder from the top block. No people.
shots.narration: 先想能不能不做、能不能换，

shots.scene: 老周在空白方案上划掉一步，换成更安全的图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man crosses out one step on a blank plan and replaces it with a safer icon.
shots.narration: 再上设备和规程，

shots.scene: 只有手套图标顶着整面墙，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A single glove icon holding up a whole wall is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护垫底，不能单靠它。

shots.section_title: 二级实验室也有两道屏障
shots.scene: 普通二级实验室，门上有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A standard teaching laboratory with a biohazard warning sign on its closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 大家常用的二级实验室，
overlay: 二级实验室也有两道屏障

shots.section_title: 二级实验室也有两道屏障
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜里操作，戴手套和实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a biological safety cabinet wearing gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 第一道：安全柜和个人防护。

shots.section_title: 二级实验室也有两道屏障
shots.scene: 关着的门、洗手池、生物危害标志三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed door, a handwashing sink and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第二道：门、洗手池和规范管理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两层同心圆前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the two concentric circles.
shots.narration: 一级护人，二级护环境。

shots.scene: 五块积木排成梯子
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the five blocks arranged as a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 五类控制，按层级配合用。

shots.scene: 阿杰关好门，向欣欣竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the laboratory door and gives the panda mascot a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 随手关门，守住屏障。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in the corridor.
shots.narration: 下一课，再一类类细讲，再见！
